hook: Sweden counts more islands than any other country: 267,570, against Indonesia's 17,500.
twist: Sweden: 267,570 by its own 2013 count, then Norway and Finland; Indonesia has about 17,500. The catch: Sweden counted islands as small as nine square metres.
angle: Countdown with flags, ending on Sweden's number and the nine-square-metre twist. One big number: 267,570.
why_now: Scout: most-islands Shorts top 50.1M (median of top 25: 3.44M) since mid-2024.
risks: National counts use different rules; Norway's figure ranges from about 55,000 (Statista) to 239,057 (Wikipedia list). Label every number 'national count, methods differ'.
